landing.title: StreamDrive Hub
landing.badge: Self-hosted LMS powered by Google Drive
landing.heroSubtitle: Turn your Google Drive folders into a browsable course catalog with video streaming, progress tracking, and a clean learning interface — all self-hosted.
landing.featuresSubtitle: A focused toolset for turning Drive into a learning platform.
landing.feature1Desc: Stream lessons directly from Drive with quality switching, chapters, subtitles, and resume support.
landing.feature2Desc: Index your Drive folders into courses and lessons with a single click. Metadata and summaries included.
landing.feature3Desc: Find any course or lesson instantly by searching across titles, descriptions, and technical summaries.
landing.feature4Desc: Auto-saved playback position and completion status per lesson. Pick up right where you left off.
landing.howSubtitle: Three steps to turn your Drive into an LMS.
landing.step1Desc: Structure your content into folders with optional course.md metadata files.
landing.step2Desc: Click Sync to index everything into your local database. Videos, summaries, all of it.
landing.step3Desc: Browse courses, stream videos, track progress — all from a clean, responsive interface.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to turn Drive into an LMS?
landing.ctaSubtitle: Self-hosted. No external services. Just your content and a clean interface to consume it.
